items.text: yeh galat hai
mai disagree karta hu
thoda zyada charge hua
haan ji
kal tak
theek hai

items.context: Aapko lagta hai amount sahi nahi hai?
items.text: hmm sahi nahi hai

items.context: Kya aapke hisaab se amount sahi hai?
items.text: nahi theek nahi hai

items.context: Kya aapko lagega ki charge sahi hai?
items.text: galat charge hua
mera monthly bill mein extra charge show ho raha hai
maine payment kar diya tha lekin amount outstanding hai
accha matlab mujhe ek baar detail samjha dijiye
charge kaafi zyada hai jo mere records ke hisaab se nahi hai
boat naam se ek transaction hua tha lekin woh galat dikhaya ja raha hai
ho sakta hai ki payment update nahi hua ho is wajah se problem hai
Thursday nahi Wednesday ko payment hua tha galti se record mein Thursday likha hai

items.context: Aapko kya lagta hai outstanding amount correct hai?
items.text: main soch raha hu amount galat hai bar bar verify karna chahiye

items.context: Kya aapne recent payment kiya hai ya nahi?
items.text: maine kal payment kiya tha lekin abhi bhi pending dikh raha hai

items.context: Aapko extension mil sakta hai kya interest charges ko lekar?
items.text: umm mujhe nahi pata ki interest charges itne zyada kyun hain

items.context: Kya payment date aapne verify ki hai?
items.text: galat date show karti hai mera payment Wednesday nahi Thursday tha

items.context: Kya aapko payment proof hai jo verify kar sake?
items.text: payment confirmation mil gaya tha par phir bhi charges kam nahi hue
mera account se paise deduct hone ke baad bhi update nahi hua hai to outstanding amount wrong dikh raha hai
main kal hi payment karne gaya tha par bank ne kaha transaction failed tha isliye amount clear nahi hua
maine socha ki fees mein kuch extra charges lage hain par actually mera due amount kam hona chahiye tha uske badle zyada bataya ja raha hai

items.context: Aapne payment dispute raise kiya tha kya update mila?
items.text: maine dispute raise kiya tha payment ka aur aapne bola tha ki verify karenge par abhi tak kuch update nahi mila

items.context: Kya aap payment receipt verify kar sakte hain?
items.text: woh jo charges aap bata rahe ho vo galat hain kyunki maine apne payment receipt cross check kiya hai aur vo different hai

items.context: Aapke contract ke hisaab se charges kya hone chahiye the?
items.text: main samajhta hu ki koi problem ho gaya hoga system mein kyunki mere contract ke hisaab se charges itne zyada nahi hone chahiye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: dispute_amount - says the outstanding amount or a charge is wrong
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
